stem: What is the historical significance of this act?

options.label: A
options.text: It was the first time Congress voted to overrule a presidential veto.

options.label: B
options.text: It represented a shift in federal power after the impeachment of President Johnson.

options.label: C
options.text: It was the first time Congress passed a law that protected racial minorities.

options.label: D
options.text: It represented the failure of northern abolitionists to influence Reconstruction policies.

visual_elements:
Provisions of the Civil Rights Act of 1866
• Designated all people born in the United States (except American Indians) as citizens
• Granted all citizens certain rights under the law
